product.description: În primăvara lui 1985, Mihail Gorbaciov, abia ales secretar general al Partidului Comunist al URSS, începea un proces de reformare a întregului sistem economic și politic sovietic. Ceea ce avea să devină cunoscut drept perestroika (bdquo;reconstrucțieldquo;) a durat doar șase ani, până în decembrie 1991, când Gorbaciov și-a dat demisia din funcția de președinte al URSS. Efectele politicii lui au fost incredibile, provocând nu doar dezmembrarea URSS și prăbușirea regimului comunist în toată Europa de Est, ci și căderea Cortinei de Fier și reunificarea Germaniei. Nu este de mirare că, în Rusia, Gorbaciov este considerat de majoritatea populației drept principalul vinovat de disoluția URSS-ului și de pierderea statutului de superputere. Le-a dat rușilor libertate, dar erau ei pregătiți să o primească? Occidentul, pe de altă parte, i-a apreciat meritele indiscutabile pe plan extern ndash; reducerea tensiunilor Războiului Rece, diminuarea arsenalului nuclear, inițierea retragerii trupelor sovietice din Afghanistan, neintervenția în afacerile interne ale țărilor din fostul bloc estic. În 1990, pentru toate aceste merite i s-a acordat Premiul Nobel pentru Pace. La 84 de ani, Mihail Sergheevici Gorbaciov rămâne unul dintre cei mai influenți (și controversați) oameni ai secolului XX. bdquo;Indiferent de ceea ce ar putea spune acum despre perestroika oponenții și criticii ei, a fost o perioadă uimitoare... Am deschis un drum pe care se putea merge mai departe. Am făcut ceea ce trebuia făcut: am dat oamenilor libertate, transparență, pluralism politic, democrație. I-am făcut liberi!ldquo; (Mihail Gorbaciov)

# Memoirs: My Life Before and After Perestroika by Litera

## Journey Through History: Understanding the Era of Perestroika

Delve into a pivotal period of 20th-century world history with *Memoirs: My Life Before and After Perestroika*. This powerful memoir offers an intimate look at the seismic shifts that redefined global politics, personal lives, and the very structure of society.

The story centers on the time when Mikhail Gorbachev, newly appointed General Secretary of the Communist Party of the USSR in the spring of 1985, began implementing sweeping reforms across the entire Soviet economic and political systemâa process known as Perestroika (reconstruction). This transformative period lasted only six years, culminating in December 1991 when Gorbachev resigned as President of the USSR.

### The Impact of Reform on Global Power Dynamics

The consequences of these policies were nothing short of extraordinary. Perestroika did more than just reform a system; it catalyzed immense change:

*   **Dissolution and Collapse:** It led directly to the dissolution of the USSR and the fall of communist regimes throughout Eastern Europe.
*   **Geopolitical Shifts:** Key historical events, including the fall of the Iron Curtain and German reunification, were influenced by these massive political tides.

The narrative explores the complex legacy of Gorbachev's tenure. In Russia, he is often viewed as the architect of the USSRâs dissolution and the loss of superpower statusâhaving granted freedom to the Russian people, but leaving them unsure if they were truly ready for it.

### A Legacy of Freedom and Controversy

The book encapsulates the profound duality of this era. On one hand, Gorbachev provided his people with unprecedented freedoms: political transparency, pluralism, and democracy. He declared, "I opened a path that could be continued... I did what needed to be done: I gave the people freedom! I made them free!"

On the other side, the world recognized his undeniable achievements on the international stage. For his effortsâreducing Cold War tensions, diminishing the nuclear arsenal, initiating the withdrawal of Soviet troops from Afghanistan, and refraining from interfering in the internal affairs of former Eastern Bloc nationsâhe was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1990.

Mikhail Sergeevich Gorbachev remains one of the most influential (and controversial) figures of the 20th century. This memoir provides a comprehensive look at the moments that defined his life and shaped modern history.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is Perestroika?**
A: Perestroika was the name of the reform process initiated by Mikhail Gorbachev in the Soviet Union starting in 1985, aiming to restructure both the economic and political systems.

**Q: Is this book purely a biography?**
A: No, it functions as a memoir, offering personal reflections on living through the tumultuous global changes caused by Perestroika and the subsequent dissolution of the USSR.

**Q: Why is Mikhail Gorbachev controversial?**
A: He is viewed differently depending on perspective; while praised for granting freedom to the people (and winning the Nobel Peace Prize), he is also criticized for the loss of superpower status and the dissolution of the Soviet Union itself.
